newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil trade deficit reaches $456 mln in March.
newsitem.headline: Brazil trade deficit reaches $456 mln in March.

text.p: Brazil notched up a $456 million trade deficit in the first two weeks of March, a spokeswoman for the Industry and Commerce Ministry said.
Imports during the period totalled $2.279 billion while exports were $1.823 billion, the spokeswoman said.

In the second week of March, exports were $861 million, down from $962 million in the first week of the month. Imports rose in March's second week to $1.182 billion from $1.097 billion in the first week.
In the first two months of 1997, Brazil reported a trade deficit of $2.031 billion, with exports of $6.831 billion and imports of $8.862 billion, the spokeswoman said.
